newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lion Teck Chiang sees S$17.5 mln 1997 net.
newsitem.headline: Lion Teck Chiang sees S$17.5 mln 1997 net.

text.p: Property and steel group Lion Teck Chiang Ltd (LTC), part of Malaysian conglomerate The Lion Group, said on Monday it expected to make a net profit of Singapore $17.5 million in its financial year to June 30, 1997.
The company said in its Singapore initial public share offer (IPO) prospectus it made a net profit of S$10.4 million in the year to June 30, 1996.
LTC earlier offered 32.52 million shares at S$1.30 each in its Singapore IPO.
The company prospectus forecast 1997 turnover at S$151.8 million and a pre-tax profit of approximately S$24.9 million.
